rows.note: For a concrete shortfall or gap in an amount, this is the all-purpose noun rather than the budget-specific 赤字.

example.english: There is still a three-thousand-dollar deficit in this month’s income.
example.traditional: 呢個月嘅收入仲有三千蚊缺口。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jyut6 ge3 sau1 jap6 zung6 jau5 saam1 cin1 man1 kyut3 hau2

rows.note: Use this for a shortage of supplies, resources, or people rather than an abstract inadequacy or accounting deficit.

example.english: The hospital is facing a deficit of nurses lately.
example.jyutping: ji1 jyun2 zeoi3 gan6 dyun2 kyut3 wu6 si6

rows.note: Use this for an abstract deficiency or inadequacy, including a shortfall in quality, especially in formal contexts.

example.english: This report points out a deficit in the company’s technical capabilities.
example.traditional: 呢份報告指出，公司嘅技術水平不足。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zi2 ceot1 gung1 si1 ge3 gei6 seot6 seoi2 ping4 bat1 zuk1

rows.note: Use this specifically for spending or liabilities exceeding revenue, especially in government or business accounts.

example.english: The government is expected to run a deficit of twenty billion this year.
example.traditional: 政府今年預計會有二百億赤字。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 gam1 nin4 jyu6 gai3 wui5 jau5 ji6 baak3 jik1 cek3 zi6
